scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend ci && uv sync --locked --project backend --python 3.12 --extra dev
scripts.dev:backend: uv run --no-sync --project backend uvicorn wavefunction.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --reload --reload-dir backend/src
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv run --no-sync pytest -n 4 --dist loadfile
scripts.test:connectors:live: cd backend && uv run --no-sync pytest tests/test_connectors.py -q -m live
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && uv run --no-sync --project backend ruff check backend
scripts.desktop:build: npm run sidecar:build && ./frontend/node_modules/.bin/tauri build --ci --config src-tauri/tauri.conf.json && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs
scripts.generate:api: uv run --no-sync --project backend python scripts/generate-openapi.py && npm run generate:api:types
